items.exampleEn: The movie is about a terrorist plan, but the hero stops it.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影在講一個恐怖分子的計畫，不過英雄阻止了它。
items.glossZh: 恐怖分子的；恐怖主義的

items.exampleEn: My sister got her driver's license yesterday.
items.exampleZh: 我姊姊昨天考到駕照了。

items.exampleEn: This video game has many fighters to choose from.
items.exampleZh: 這款電玩有很多戰士角色可以選。

items.exampleEn: Liberty means you can choose your own way.
items.exampleZh: 自由就是你可以選擇自己要走的路。

items.exampleEn: The road is closed for repairs.
items.exampleZh: 這條路因為整修而封閉。

items.exampleEn: Can I have a stamp and an envelope?
items.exampleZh: 可以給我一張郵票和一個信封嗎？

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother is a fighter. She never gives up.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶是個鬥士，她從不放棄。

items.audioEn: The repair will take two days and cost fifty dollars.
items.audioZh: 這次修理要兩天，費用是五十元。

items.sentenceEn: You need a license to drive a taxi.
Airports check every bag to stop terrorist attacks.
items.sentenceZh: 機場會檢查每一個包包，以防止恐怖攻擊。

items.stemEn: Please write the address on the ____.
You can't take photos here without ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有得到許可，你不能在這裡拍照。

items.passageEn: Last month, my uncle went to America for the first time. In one big city, he visited the Statue of Liberty and learned why it is a symbol of liberty. Then he wanted to rent a car, so he showed his license at a shop near his hotel. The car needed a small repair first, but the shop did it for free. Before he came home, he sent us a card in a big envelope. Inside, there was also a photo of him and the statue!
items.passageZh: 上個月，我叔叔第一次去美國。他在一座大城市參觀了自由女神像，也知道了為什麼它是自由的象徵。後來他想租車，就在飯店附近的一家店出示了駕照。那輛車要先小修一下，不過店家免費幫他修好了。回國前，他用一個大信封寄了一張卡片給我們。信封裡還有一張他和自由女神像的合照！

questions.questionZh: 叔叔在大城市參觀了什麼？
大信封裡除了卡片，還有什麼？
options: 他和自由女神像的合照

items.promptZh: 你需要家長的許可才能參加。
referenceEn: You need your parents' permission to join.
You need permission from your parents to join.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 need permission to＋原形動詞

items.instructionZh: 用 repair 造一個句子，說說你修過或需要修理的東西。
referenceEn: I repaired my bike last weekend.
rubricZh: repair 可當名詞或動詞（例如 needs a repair、repaired my bike）
時態配合句意（例如 needs、repaired）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「恐怖份子的」：台灣教育部標準寫法為「恐怖分子」（份子為常見異寫）；建議統一用「分子」。（疑似，視專案用字規範）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "恐怖分子的；恐怖主義的"（原 "恐怖份子的；恐怖主義的"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：份子→分子，同釋義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "這部電影在講一個恐怖分子的計畫，不過英雄阻止了它。"（原 "這部電影在講一個恐怖份子的計畫，不過英雄阻止了它。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：本課字 liberty 在閱讀中只出現在專有名詞 "the Statue of Liberty"，沒有示範「自由」的詞義；Statue of Liberty 也未列入 properNouns。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last month, my uncle went to America for the first time. In one big city, he visited the Statue of Liberty and learned why it is a symbol of liberty. Then he wanted to rent a car, so he showed his license at a shop near his hotel. The car needed a small repair first, but the shop did it for free. Before he came home, he sent us a card in a big envelope. Inside, there was also a photo of him and the statue!"（原 "Last month, my uncle went to America for the first time. In one big city, he visited the Statue of Liberty. Then he wanted to rent a car, so he showed his license at a car shop. The car needed a small repair first, but the shop did it for free. Before he came home, he sent us a card in a big envelope. Inside, there was also a receipt from a famous restaurant!"）；另一條第②關：car shop 不道地、結尾收據動機不明。liberty 改為有詞義的用法（a symbol of liberty）；car shop→a shop near his hotel；收據改為他和雕像的合照

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯配合英文修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "上個月，我叔叔第一次去美國。他在一座大城市參觀了自由女神像，也知道了為什麼它是自由的象徵。後來他想租車，就在飯店附近的一家店出示了駕照。那輛車要先小修一下，不過店家免費幫他修好了。回國前，他用一個大信封寄了一張卡片給我們。信封裡還有一張他和自由女神像的合照！"（原 "上個月，我叔叔第一次去美國。他在一座大城市參觀了自由女神像。後來他想租車，就在租車行出示了駕照。那輛車要先小修一下，不過車行免費幫他修好了。回國前，他用一個大信封寄了一張卡片給我們。信封裡竟然還有一張有名餐廳的收據！"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（「一家有名餐廳的收據」9 字 vs 3–4 字），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["他和自由女神像的合照","一張美國的地圖","一些美國的硬幣"]（原 ["一家有名餐廳的收據","一張照片","一些錢"]）；短文結尾改寫，正解同步；長度另由全級名次分布規則處理
